cards.text: VEL-WEEKENDER-MENSID-01 — 'YOU'VE SEEN THIS SHAPE'

cards.title: CONCEPT
cards.text: Men's TOF AI UGC greenscreen, ~55s, Eleanor Weekender. Hook is a real photograph of Erling Haaland with his travel bag, full-bleed, our creator keyed over the bottom holding OUR bag. Then the price relief lands at 0:06 and the whole body is TRAVEL: hotel room, carry-on handle, terminal concourse, overhead bin, laptop into the slip pocket. Three male avatars 32-33 read the same script. B-roll grammar comes from three iPhone-shot TikToks broken down at 1fps: a studio ranking (full-body carry pose), an airport gate unpack (the most iPhone-native), and a hotel carry-on load (the hero grammar). A MAN IS CARRYING, PACKING OR MOVING THE BAG IN EVERY B-ROLL FRAME. The two-options duffel bind is cut. One law-forced rewrite: Brooks's 'they're all thousands of dollars' quotes a competitor price, so the gap is resolved by stating OUR price instead and letting the viewer do the subtraction.
REF C

cards.text: NOTES

cards.title: SHIPPED TO REVIEW — 9/01
cards.text: Three finished cuts in final/. Beats are timed off the ElevenLabs character alignment, so captions are word-synced and every cut lands on the same frame for all three creators. Creator PiP at 36% width: centred on the hook (reference construction), bottom-left through the body, jumps bottom-right at the overhead-bin beat. Chromakey per render at 0.08/0.03 with sampled green, light despill. PDP close is the real recording and ENDS on the buy box. Stills are hard cuts, no zoom. Known upgrade path once kie is topped up: swap K06/K08/K09/K10/K11 for Omni motion clips, regen the three hardware nits (K02 straps, K09 distant hardware, K11 band plate), upscale picks to 2K.

cards.title: PASS 1 GENERATED — WHAT YOU ARE APPROVING
cards.text: Every OUR VERSION frame below is now a GENERATED keyframe of a man with OUR bag, not a reference screenshot. One consistent creator through the whole trip (K08 anchored K03's face). Approve scenes here; on approval the picks get a hardware-nit regen pass (K02 strap placement, K09 distant hardware, K11 band plate), upscale to 2K, then Omni animation. Full verdicts in QA-LOG.md. Engine note: kie gpt-image-2 rejects long prompts at 2K since 9/01, so this pass rendered at 1K.

cards.title: VOICE + RENDER PIPELINE
cards.text: Voice cloned from tiktok @talktoteva (ElevenLabs teva-yapper-male). VO take 1 is a single eleven_v3 read, 60.96s, STT-gated: all 149 words present, brand onset clean, no tempo change. Uploaded to HeyGen (audio asset ready, 884 API credits). Each picked avatar frame becomes a HeyGen photo avatar and renders on Avatar V against that one VO, so all three creators land on identical timecodes and only the corner changes — a clean creator-only test. Then key bottom-left over the b-roll at roughly a quarter of frame height.

cards.title: THE ONE LINE I CHANGED
cards.text: Brooks's direction was 'everyone has seen Haaland with all of these Birkin bags, but the problem is they're all thousands of dollars.' That is a competitor price comparison and it quotes a Hermes price. Both are banned, and the Birkin clearance is specific: legal as a shape mechanism, never as a comparison, never with a Hermes price, never ranked against anything. So the gap gets resolved by stating OUR price instead, early and flat, and the viewer does the subtraction. Same relief, no banned comparison, and it pulls the price forward to 0:06 where the direction wanted the problem solved. Overrule and I will write the original.

cards.title: THE AESTHETIC, NON-NEGOTIABLE
cards.text: Shot on an iPhone. Handheld with micro-shake, no gimbal, no dolly. Practical light only: hotel lamp and window for the room, terminal fluorescents for the gate. iPhone-native depth, shallow on macro inserts and deep everywhere else, never cinema bokeh. Slightly imperfect framing, a beat of focus hunt on inserts, the odd tilt. No grade. If a move looks operated, it is wrong.

cards.title: WHERE THE ASPIRATION ACTUALLY LIVES
cards.text: In the situations, not the copy. Hotel room with a carry-on already packed. Bag riding the handle through a terminal. Overhead bin, never a bag drop. Laptop going into leather. The script never says luxury, never says elevated, and never mentions the athlete again after 0:02. The man in the b-roll is simply living the life the hook pointed at. That is the whole argument.

cards.title: DO
cards.text: A MAN IS CARRYING, PACKING OR MOVING THE BAG IN EVERY B-ROLL FRAME. Static product frames are not b-roll. One man, one outfit, one bag, one trip: hotel room, terminal, cabin, hotel room. Creator keyed bottom-left the entire runtime, roughly a quarter of frame height. Word-synced captions above him. New visual every 3.5s. One continuous VO. Say eighteen inches out loud. Feed the brand to TTS as Vell-Ahn-Trah.

cards.title: DON'T
cards.text: No competitor brand named, no competitor price, no Hermes price, no ranking. Never gender the bag, never defend it. No shoulder carry ever, the rolled handles cannot reach. No bag on a terminal floor. No season word. Do not type Birkin into any generation prompt, the kie claims-grep hard-fails. No Ken Burns on a still to fake motion. No cutaway to a second creator or an unrelated location.

cards.title: THREE AVATARS — 32 to 33
cards.text: M1: tall and heavy-framed, closest to the hook silhouette. Short cropped hair, light stubble, backwards cap, oversized black tailored jacket over a white tee, black trousers, white high-tops. M2: tall and lean, longer hair pushed back, clean shaven, cream open overshirt and light straight jeans. M3: broad and athletic, buzzed hair, full short beard, glasses, black hoodie up, dark trousers, wired earbuds — deliberately the Ref B gate look. Same script, three reads, three creatives to test. Whichever ships, his stated height must match how he renders.

cards.title: ENGINE ROUTING
cards.text: F01 is a real photograph plus a keyed cutout, composited, not generated. F04 and F07 are GPT Image 2 i2i STILLS ONLY, hard cuts either side, because the open-bag mechanism has failed on Seedance 2.0 and 2.5 even from validated keyframes. Everything else that moves is Omni. Seedance gets nothing.

cards.title: PER-FRAME QA COUNTS
cards.text: ONE knurled mushroom-head post at front centre. ONE oval keyhole plate, on the flap tab, NEVER on the band. TWO staples, each of two parallel flat gold bars. TWO rolled handles, upright, never drooping. ONE gold eyelet per side face. Interior is smooth caramel leather with a wide caramel slip pocket, never cream canvas. Zero lettering anywhere. Any miss is a FAIL and a regenerate, not a note.
